atomicPersistence.selection: Highest eligible valid generation wins; different identities at one highest eligible generation fail closed.
atomicPersistence.composition: Checkpoint evidence is validated against the unrecovered payload before normal non-canonical recovery runs.

authorityBoundary.statement: Lease and checkpoint coordination may permit or reject persistence but does not define or mutate canonical physical rules.

benchmark.boundary: The existing benchmark does not measure writer lease, checkpoint admission, fencing, fsync, or contention performance.

claimBoundary: Writer fencing applies to cooperating writers using the lease APIs, not hostile raw filesystem writers.
Lease time uses supplied finite milliseconds; distributed clock safety is not established.
The final lease/base check and primary rename are not one kernel-enforced compare-and-swap operation.
The operational hash covers selected coordination projections; payloadHash protects the complete serialized world.
The append-only lease ledger currently has no verified archival or garbage collection.
Checkpoint admission does not freeze arbitrary caller mutation throughout asynchronous save.
Complete parent and fencing lineage verification is not implemented.
Process-exit recovery is not universal sudden-power-loss evidence.
No production-scale, massive-world, multiplayer, independent-worker, emergent-story, or AI claim is established.
